purpose: Establishes which artifact controls PRESENT canonical state for identity/authority/runtime questions, so historical/source IDs and superseded audits can never again be mistaken for current independent programs or current defects.

current_controlling_research_closure.role: Controls final disposition for the 31 authority-vetoed records, BC DAVE, Ohio, Nevada, and Czech identity lineage as of this pass.

current_implementation_manifest.role: The SOLE executable source of authority_disposition/blocks_economic_candidacy for every program_slug. Any CSV/MD describing a program's authority state is a SNAPSHOT of this file at the time it was written -- this file, read live, always controls.

current_canonical_identity_and_alias_sou.role: The SOLE executable source for resolving a historical/source/proposed ID to its surviving canonical program_slug BEFORE any priceability question is asked. An ID absent from these sources but present in an audit CSV is historical documentation, never a live candidate.

current_authority_source.role: The SOLE executable source of BLOCKING_STATES vs PROVENANCE_DISCLOSURE_STATES for every program_slug. A dormant DoctrineRecord/RateRule existing in program_rate_rules_worldwide.py does NOT, by itself, grant authority -- this registry is the sole gate.

current_runtime_acceptance_source.role: Records what was directly verified against the real executable pipeline (discovery -> price_segment -> resolve_program_rate -> optimizer) for this pass's bounded scope, superseding any prior runtime-acceptance claim for the same records.

precedence_rule: When any two artifacts disagree about a program's CURRENT state: (1) the live executable registries (authority_coverage_registry.py, program_rate_rules_worldwide.py, program_rate_rules.py, canonical_executable_registry.py) always control over any CSV/MD description of them; (2) among CSV/MD artifacts, the one with the LATEST commit timestamp on the implementation branch (claude/audit-frametax-features-NZcX5) controls over any artifact read from a research/audit branch; (3) a research/audit branch artifact (e.g. codex/305-program-delta-audit-20260915) is read-only input, never itself controlling state, and is never merged.

current_gross_up_forensic_research.role: Latest research-only transaction treatment and documented authority gaps for the 658 unique economic identities; supersedes earlier research statements only within cap-headroom/deferment/reinvestment methodology.
current_gross_up_forensic_research.runtime_effect: NONE. Live executable registries remain controlling. This entry does not authorize automatic gross-up or alter optimizer behavior.
